extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons institutional users (Signing Officials, Admins, PIs, TTO administrators, and other role-holders who manage institution profiles and delegations)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for viewing, editing, and maintaining an organization's Institution Profile (IPF) and managing user delegations in the eRA Commons system, including role-based access, required fields, assurances/certifications, and save/discard behaviors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to the Institution Profile (IPF) is limited by role
rubrics_metrics.description: If you hold one of the following Commons roles, you have access to the Institution Profile: AA, AO, ASST, BO, FSR, PI, POSTDOC, SCIENTIST, SPONSOR, or SO. Not every Commons user will have access; only users with the SO role can edit the profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: iEdison uses parts of the IPF: some iEdison users can view the profile; iEdison TTO users and admin can view; only TTO admin can edit iEdison-maintained info. Exceptions: institutions with a TTO Administrator and no Signing Official allow the TTO Administrator to edit all profile sections; if both SO and TTO Administrator exist, TTO Administrator can only edit the Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Profile main sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institution Profile consists of two main sections – Institution Basic Information and Institutional Assurances and Certifications – and a dashboard that is always present.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sections are viewable by those with access; SO-role users can edit. Related topics for each component are available via links in the help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dashboard status indicators (green check / red X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Next to each navigation link (Basic Information, Assurances & Certifications) is a status indicator providing a visual indication of whether all required fields for that component are complete: a green check indicates complete; a red X indicates missing information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Assurances & Certifications, the green check indicates ORI Certification is valid and not expired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing vs Editing modes
rubrics_metrics.description: View mode provides a read-only summary of information; Edit mode (available to SO role) expands the component tile to display editable fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methods to view/expand: click a component heading, select View button, select View All to show summaries of all components. Selecting Edit places you in edit mode for all components (though may open only the selected tile).

rubrics_metrics.name: Save All is required to persist edits
rubrics_metrics.description: When editing the Institution Profile, selecting the Save All button is the only method of saving changes you have made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Save All keeps you in edit mode so you may continue updating. Hiding or closing a component without Save All does not save changes; navigating away will lose edits if Save All is not used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discard Changes behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: To discard unsaved edits, select the Discard Changes button and confirm Yes in the pop-up; any information added since the last Save All will be lost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Discard Changes only when you intend to abandon unsaved modifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field-level and component-level required-field error indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: If required information is missing from a Basic Information section, a message displays across the top of the screen, the Basic Information link displays in red font, and the header of the component in error displays in red; additional error messages (red text) display at the field level within the component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expand the component to see and correct field-level errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tile expansion and view controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Tiles (components) can be expanded/collapsed by clicking the heading, using the View button on the component header, selecting View All to expand all, or selecting Hide/Hide All to collapse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In edit mode you can expand multiple tiles for editing by selecting their View buttons; Edit on any component places the profile into edit mode for all components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Only SO (Signing Official) role can edit most IPF components (with TTO exceptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Commons users with the SO role can edit the Institution Profile. Exception: institutions with a TTO Administrator and no Signing Official allow the TTO Administrator to edit all sections; if both exist, the TTO Administrator can only edit the Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of local institutional role assignments before attempting edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Name component — Profile Name and Commons Preferred Name
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institution Name component allows viewing of the Profile Name (NIH-designated) and Commons Preferred Name (institution-specified). If you hold the SO role you can edit the Commons Preferred Name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Commons Preferred Name is not a required field. After editing, select Save All or Discard Changes as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Contact Information — required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institution Contact Information component contains fields for Notice of Award Email, Announcements & Notifications Email, Closeout Correspondence Email, Contact Name, Contact Phone, and Contact Email; these are required and display as read-only unless you hold the SO role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH uses these specific email addresses for Notice of Award, general announcements/notifications, and closeout correspondence. Enter primary contact details accurately; use Save All to persist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Award Email usage
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH uses the Notice of Award Email address entered here to send all notices of award for a grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure this email address is accurate and monitored by appropriate institutional staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcements & Notifications Email usage
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH uses this email address to send grant reminders, system notifications, and general correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This address should be used by staff who should receive system-wide notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout Correspondence Email usage
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH uses this email address to send any Closeout related communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This should be an address monitored by staff responsible for grant closeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: About the Institution — Primary and Secondary DUNS handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary DUNS, Secondary DUNS, Organization Type, and Ownership Control display in About the Institution; Primary DUNS is read-only (set at registration), Secondary DUNS can be added/edited/removed by SOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To change Primary DUNS contact the eRA Service Desk. To add a Secondary DUNS select Add and enter 9 required digits and optional 4 digits (for 13-digit DUNS), edit by updating text fields, or remove via Remove button with confirmation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal-Wide Assurance (FWA) numbers — add/edit/remove
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWA is an assurance accepted/approved by OHRP for institutions engaged in non-exempt human subjects research. SOs can add, edit, or remove FWA numbers in the profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add an FWA, select Add to display an editable text field and enter the number. To remove, select Remove next to the number and confirm Yes at the confirmation dialog.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Welfare Assurance Number — display-only (OLAW-supplied)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Animal Welfare Assurance Number field displays the number passed to Commons from OLAW; if existing, old-format numbers are shown in parentheses. This field is not editable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any changes to this number must be handled through the originating authority (OLAW) — do not attempt to edit in Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary DUNS is not editable in Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: The Primary DUNS field reflects the primary DUNS provided during original institution registration and is not editable through Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To change the primary DUNS, contact the eRA Service Desk for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Cost Negotiations fields and formats
rubrics_metrics.description: The Indirect Cost Negotiations component allows viewing/editing of Negotiator Name and Last Negotiation Date; these fields are viewable by all with IPF access and editable by SO role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Last Negotiation date must be entered in MM/DD/YYYY format. Negotiator Name is a non-required editable field; Last Negotiation is non-required but must follow the date format if entered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signing Officials & TTO Administrators listing (read-only fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: This component lists all system users in your organization assigned SO and/or TTO Administrator roles and displays Name, Phone Number, and Email Address as read-only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this list to identify institutional role-holders; editing role assignments occurs elsewhere in Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Address required and optional fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institution Address component contains Street Address, City, Country, State, Zip Code, Phone (required) and Fax (optional). Most are required fields and are editable by SO role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country and State are selected from drop-down lists; ensure formatting and completeness before selecting Save All.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component fields
rubrics_metrics.description: This component provides contact and administration information for the institution's technology transfer office; viewable by those with access and editable by TTO_Admin or SO role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editable fields include Street Address, City, Country, State/Province, Zip/Postal Code, Contact Name, Phone, Email, 'Are batch uploads allowed by this organization?' (Yes/No drop-down), 'The month that begins the utilization period' (drop-down), and 'Are the inventions submitted by the organization assigned for administration and reporting by the user?' (Yes/No drop-down).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Assurances & Certifications — Status and expiration display
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status section displays the Office of Research and Integrity Certification Status for the institution with values either 'Assurance OK' or 'Expired'; expired status displays in red text as a warning. The expiration date displays below the status and in red text if already expired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor ORI certification expiration to avoid expired-assurance warnings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurances & Certifications list — compliance indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: The Assurances and Certifications section provides a checklist for indicating compliance with particular laws, policies, or regulations and research requirements. Read-only check marks display next to each assurance/certification along with the date the institution indicated compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all assurances apply to every institution. For complete definitions refer to Part III of the SF424 (R&R) Application Guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurance: Non-discrimination compliance indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: This institution complies with all laws, policies and regulations prohibiting discrimination based on: Age Discrimination Assurance; Civil Rights Assurance; Handicapped Individuals Assurance; Inclusion of Children Policy; Sex Discrimination Assurance; Women and Minority Inclusion Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SOs can check/uncheck indicators as appropriate when editing assurances; use the (explain your answer) link to provide additional information if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurance: Other institutional compliance indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: This institution complies with laws and regulations regarding ClinicalTrials.gov Requirement; Conflict of Interest Assurance; Delinquent Debt Assurance; Drugfree Workplace Assurance; Impact of Grant Activities on the Environment and Historic Properties; Institutional Debarment Assurance; Lobbying Assurance; Smoke-Free Workplace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edit these indicators via Edit Assurances and Certifications button; provide explanations where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research-specific assurances and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Research at this institution meets requirements for Graduate Student Training for Doctoral Degrees (particular activity codes), Human Subjects, PI Assurance, Prohibited Research, Recombinant DNA and Human Gene Transfer, Research Misconduct, Research With Human Embryonic Stem Cells, Select Agent Research, Transplantation of Human Fetal Tissue, and Vertebrate Animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SOs should select the appropriate checkboxes for applicable research assurances and may use the (explain your answer) text box to provide further detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing Assurances & Certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: To edit assurance and certification indicators, SOs select the Edit Assurances and Certifications button; indicators display across several categories and can be checked or unchecked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the (explain your answer) link to open a text box for additional information when answering; Save All to persist changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: My Current Delegates display and checkmark indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: My Current Delegates shows the delegated user with a checkmark in the associated column for each authority granted. If all authorities are revoked, that user no longer displays in the table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegation checkmarks correspond to specific authorities (Progress Report, Sponsor, Submit, PPF, Status, xTrain, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Delegations parameters and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Search parameters for delegates include Commons ID, Last Name, First Name, Middle Name, and Role(s). Roles display in a drop-down where one or more may be selected. The percent sign (%) may be used as a wildcard; hold CTRL to select multiple roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select Search to run the search; Cancel returns to the previous screen. Matching users display in Search Results with name, role(s), Commons ID, and delegated authorities. Use pagination arrows to navigate multiple pages; Clear clears parameters and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretation of delegated authorities in search results
rubrics_metrics.description: Any marked checkboxes under Progress Report, Sponsor, Submit, PPF, Status, and xTrain authorities indicate that the user already has the specific authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review checkboxes in search results before re-delegating to avoid redundant assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit Delegations: marking/unmarking checkboxes to grant or revoke
rubrics_metrics.description: To edit delegations for users on your account, click Select by the user, then on the Delegate Authority screen mark checkboxes to add authorities or unmark to revoke them. Select Save to persist changes or Cancel to return without saving.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commons grants or revokes authority immediately and sends an email notifying the selected user of the change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of delegations and notification
rubrics_metrics.description: To remove delegations, select the user, uncheck the appropriate authority checkboxes, and select Save. Commons revokes the specified authority and sends an email informing the user. If all authorities are revoked, the user will be removed from the My Current Delegates table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cancel aborts the action and returns to My Delegates screen; check My Current Delegates to confirm checkmarks removed.
